purpose: Provisional discovery-based estimate of the whole-game code universe so a global percentage can be shown. Not a frozen denominator and not a proof of completeness.
method: ARM BL call targets plus push {..., lr} / stmdb sp!,{...,lr} prologues, deduplicated per module, at 4-byte alignment. Function count is the number of distinct entry candidates; code bytes is the sum of entry-to-next-entry extents, so data pools and inter-function gaps are included in the byte total. The inventory itself is still incomplete, so this is a lower bound with a wide margin at best.
caveats: Discovered entries can include interior targets and miss unreferenced functions; the true totals differ in both directions.
Overlays and ARM7 dominate the estimate; the current verified backend only reconstructs bounded ARM9 leaves.
Whole-game coverage remains unknown; the global percentage derived from this estimate is provisional and must be labelled as such.
